svg.title: AI mentor system architecture — three inputs into AI reasoning engine producing real-time mentor actions
svg.desc: Structural flowchart showing three input streams (camera feed, course/lab content, IDE environment) feeding into a central AI reasoning engine (VLM + LLM), which produces real-time mentor-style diagnostic actions back to the robot platform and learner dashboard.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the camera feed capture and how is it sampled?')
sendPrompt('How does the frame sampler work?')
sendPrompt('What telemetry is captured alongside the camera?')
sendPrompt('What course and lab content is loaded into the AI context?')
sendPrompt('How is the circuit ground truth schema used?')
sendPrompt('What is the expected robot behaviour definition?')
sendPrompt('What IDE data is streamed into the AI engine?')
sendPrompt('How does the live code snapshot work?')
sendPrompt('What runtime data comes from the serial monitor?')
sendPrompt('What does the VLM do with the camera frame?')
sendPrompt('How does the prompt builder combine all three inputs?')
sendPrompt('What is the role of the context injector?')
sendPrompt('What does the LLM reasoning core produce?')
sendPrompt('How does the diagnosis classifier categorise issues?')
sendPrompt('Give me an example of a real-time motor correction action')
sendPrompt('Show more examples of motor voltage correction commands')
sendPrompt('How does the AI generate a code patch suggestion?')
sendPrompt('How are wiring corrections delivered to the learner?')
sendPrompt('What does the voice and text feedback channel do?')
sendPrompt('What event is pushed to the mentor dashboard?')
sendPrompt('When does the flash gate open?')

svg.text: Robot executes action → camera re-reads → AI re-evaluates → next instruction
